REMINDER-I 
dated: 
- 3 JUL 2017 
To 
Sir, 
All ACCs (Zonal Offices) 
All Regional PF Commissioners (In-Charge of Regions) 
All Officers-In-Charge of SROs 
Subject:Grant of exemption from EDU Scheme, 1976 U/ s 17 ( 2A) of the EPS & 
MP Act,1952 -reg. 
Kind attention is invited to the circular issued by Head Office No.EDLI/ 5 ( 1) 
Exemption/ Extention/ 17/29967 dated 06.02.2017. 
2. 
All the Addi. Central P.F. Commissioners are requested to conduct review of the files 
in respect of each establishment in the regions, under their jurisdiction and submit the proposal 
which are due for further extension of exemption and also fresh proposals for grant of exemptio11, 
if any. All pending proposals for extension of exemption or grant of exemption in relaxed cases 
received upto 31.12.2016 must be forwarded to Head Office at the earliest along with reasons for 
delay in each case. 
3. 
Under the provisions of EDLI Scheme, 1976 loyalty cum survival benefits and 
Minimum death benefits of Rs.2.5 lakhs are under consideration. Therefore, it has been decided 
that relaxation should not be given to any establishment under para 28(7) of the EDLI Scheme, 
1976 henceforth, till further orders, to avoid any possible complication m future. Proposals 1ece1veu 
for exemption should be examined and forwarded to Head Office for approval in due course. 
Yours faithfully,
